title: QiMH Collapsible Colander and Strainer, 5 Quart(1.25 gal), Heavey Duty Kitchen Drainer Basket for Pasta, Veggies and Fruits, New Home Apartment Essentials
description:
About this item
Foldable and space-saving design - Ergonomic, space-saving design. Strainers are foldable, so they do not take up much room in your kitchen cupboards.
Easy to use - This round colander drains most foods like spaghetti, pasta, potatoes, broccoli, green beans, carrots, spinach, and other veggies, to rinse your salad leaves, fruits, and fresh vegetables
Safe - Using environmentally friendly Rubber and plastic materials, no smell.
Multi-use - You can use it in or over a sink and freestanding on a counter or table.
Good service - If you are not satisfied with the collapsible colanders, please feel free to contact us, we promise to help you solve any problems within 24 hours.
